messages:
incident-bot: Pager fired - INC-5321. Region: us-west. Symptom: sustained 5xx spike on hosted inference (api-gateway 502/504 + worker 5xx). p95 latency rising. Initial impact: % of requests failing ~3-4%. Severity flagged by bot as P2.

ana: taking this. triage started. seeing KV cache evictions + OOM events on a subset of workers. will check pod logs and node metrics.

josh: on call standby, can help with node rotation / routing. ping me if you want me to take over primary. @li-chen fyi.

ana: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction . quick probes I ran: 
```bash
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | egrep "inference-worker|router"
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-worker-42 --tail=200
```
Kv eviction counts are high on pods 42,45,48. kernel OOM messages on node-12.

li-chen: i'm going to prepare a fallback route to eu-west and coordinate a partial traffic shift. can we avoid full failover to prevent cache cold start?

kai: i'm starting a scale up for inference-worker in us-west: replicas 4 -> 6 with the ops script now: `./ops-scale --cluster us-west --service inference-worker --replicas 6`. will post result.

ana: pinged CS to notify top affected customers (IDs: C-101, C-214, C-330). putting short note in INC-5321.

josh: observed GC pause spikes on pod 45 (20s) right before 5xx burst. draining node-12 now to reprovision.

incident-bot: Update: INC-5321 status -> triage in progress. Alerts: 5xx-rate (firing), kv-eviction (firing -> partially resolved).

ana: mitigations applied: scaled replicas, drained node-12, started partial traffic shift 30% to eu-west. current metrics: 5xx down to ~2.1% after scale, p95 ~380ms. still above baseline.

li-chen: traffic shift command used (control plane):
```json
{
  "route": "hosted-us-west",
  "fallback": "hosted-eu-west",
  "percent": 30
}
```
API call: `POST /api/v1/routes/shift` with auth token.

kai: note from ops: runbook warns cache warmup will cause transient errors for ~5-10m after shift. expect a short blip.

ana: handoff prep: I'm primary until 04:00 PST. josh will be secondary after I handoff. If you want to take primary, type `take` in thread.

ana: short checklist for handoff:
- ongoing alerts: `5xx-rate` (us-west) still firing
- mitigations in progress: scale up completed, node drain in progress, partial traffic shift 30%
- next steps: monitor p95/p99 and 5xx for 10m; if 5xx > 5% escalate to full shift (additional 70%)
- runbook steps: see runbook section 2 (node drains) and 4 (traffic shift)
- logs to watch: inference-worker stderr, router-proxy 502/504 entries, kubelet events
- customer comms: CS notified for top-5; update in INC-5321 if impact changes

josh: taking primary now. i'm on until 08:00 PST. I'll post updates every 15m or on state change. my immediate plan: watch error rate for 15m and prepare to increase shift to 80% if we don't see recovery.

oncall-rota: NOTE: primary=josh, secondary=li-chen until 08:00 PST. bridge: #incident-bridge is open.

ana: leaving detailed PagerDuty note and attaching logs (pod-45 + node-12). I'm signing off at 03:58 PST. good luck team :wave:

josh: acknowledged. taking over. action items for next 15m:
- verify router error logs for request pattern
- if 5xx > 5% after 10m -> escalate to full 80% shift and trigger customer comms update
- if new OOMs appear -> escalate to infra for node sizing/manual intervention

incident-bot: Reminder: escalation path -> SEV1 if customer impact >20% or >3 customers reporting degraded service. Call escalation if needed. :eyes:

li-chen: i'll keep watch on the fallback and be ready to ramp up eu-west. leaving a note about cache-warmup latency in the runbook.

josh: update 15:05 UTC: 5xx hovering ~1.8%, p95 350ms. keeping at 30% shift. will re-evaluate at 15:20 UTC.
